name: Jenny's Schlössl
beschreibung: The 4-star hotel Jenny's Schlössl enjoys a quiet, scenic location in Serfaus on Tyrol's sun-drenched high plateau. The property combines castle-inspired architecture with contemporary alpine luxury. Tastefully decorated rooms and suites afford panoramic views across the Samnaun Range and Ötztal Alps. For relaxation, guests have access to a lavish spa and sauna world, complete with an indoor pool and serene relaxation lounges. The restaurant elevates half-board dining into a gourmet celebration highlighting fresh regional ingredients. With the village subway close by, the modern cable cars of Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis are just moments away.
kurzbeschreibung: Elegant 4-star superior holiday hotel in Serfaus on the sunny alpine plateau of Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis.
